a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we'll almost certainly both be caught with empty units. The reserve only has 4 now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'd like to revise the agreement openly rather than break it quietly. Options: (a) we stick to the plan and operate, or (b) one of us takes 4 now and the other gets the next 4 after generating. I won't take without telling you first. What's your view and your next action?

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Okay, I'm keeping to the agreement and operating this round, as I promised I wouldn't take without warning you. I still think the storm risk makes waiting very costly. If we survive this round, please consider letting one of us take 4 as soon as it's available, with the other getting the next 4. I'll tell you before I change my action.
